title: Sapient
summary: Self-custody wallet for Tari Ootle. The Chrome Web Store review on November 19 shows extension 0.10.1, updated November 18; its older testnet-only overview does not override retained creator mainnet/testnet deployment evidence. Separately, Android 0.10.2 was published November 19 for Android 10 or newer. Its release notes describe recovery when a private fee UTXO was already spent, earlier balance correction and updated Ootle libraries. These are creator release claims. No APK or extension was acquired or installed, and no wallet was connected or transaction submitted. The recording shows the Android 0.10.2 announcement; Chrome and Android versions remain separate.
cardSummary: Manage Ootle accounts with Sapient’s browser wallet, or explore its Android release with NFT and token tools.
